quarterly_data.signal: Customer YILING TRADING: correction filing (rcept 20261016800871) for the semiconductor inspection equipment supply contract first disclosed 07-29-2026 (China, KRW 10,523,650,500 = USD 7,177,500 converted at KRW 1,466.20/USD on 07-29-2026, export so VAT excluded, 20.72% of 2025 consolidated revenue KRW 50,777,866,585; term 07-29-2026 to 04-10-2027). The contract covers three orders and the stated end date is the latest of them; because of changed delivery dates, the first equipment-1 order now runs to 01-25-2027 (was 10-15-2026) and the equipment-2 order to 12-20-2026 (was 12-10-2026), while the second equipment-1 order still ends 04-10-2027 (last delivery date). Contract date = the day the purchase order was received by email; no down payment, payment 70% before shipment and 30% after final approval. [supply agreement; signed 07-29-2026]
